title: Phase 5 decision memo (applies the frozen rule reanalysis/rule_frozen.yaml)

primary_outcome.estimand: E1 rtk x compaction, per-turn PT interaction Y11-Y10-Y01+Y00

why_this_is_a_result_not_a_non_finding: Editor point 3 (normalise by turns, not raw token sums) is implemented: per-turn normalisation tightened the CI from +/-48k (raw) to +/-1.5k, and the interaction is still null. The null is now precise, not an artifact of aggregation noise.

The Oaxaca decomposition of Eq.8 gives a clean, positive statement: the -27,039-token saving of the full intervention pair is 98% per-turn (occupancy) and ~3% replay (trajectory), remainder 1.3%. Savings are per-turn, not trajectory-driven, for this pair.

Determinism/degeneracy diagnostic: 104/144 E2 runs (72%) are process-degenerate (temperature-0.2 duplicate/trivial trajectories), so nominal replication is largely illusory. This is a reusable measurement artifact and explains why aggregate token sums were so noisy.

turns_interaction_e1.verdict: null; trajectory length ~18-19 turns in every cell

e2_gt_per_turn_interaction_DESCRIPTIVE.caveat: collider (degeneracy loads on CoD arms 28 vs 24) + gt=11 collapse; descriptive only

paper_under_this_branch_D_prime.contribution: Analytic budget-recurrence model (Eqs 4-8) that PREDICTS the replay/trajectory split a priori, CALIBRATED against measured runs. The observed 98%/3% per-turn/replay split for the compaction+rtk pair is the calibration datum.
paper_under_this_branch_D_prime.positioning_vs_concurrent_work: Cite arXiv:2607.12161 (posted 2026-07-14, one day before the 2026-07-15 freeze, on RTK specifically) and arXiv:2608.16370 (Aug 2026) as independent, concurrent corroboration reached by a different (paired provider-billed) method. They MEASURE the split; this work DERIVES its magnitude from a recurrence model. TMLR does not score novelty, so concurrency is neutral-to-positive.
must_fix_from_corpus_gate: Relabel SAC as cost-of-pass v=C/R and cite arXiv:2504.13359 (+ Efficient Agents 2508.02694, AI Agents That Matter 2407.01502).

Add ACON (2510.00615), AgentDiet (2509.23586), LightThinker++ (2604.03679) to the taxonomy; re-scope C1 to an honest, narrow claim (no strict two-method cross-category composition with individual baselines found), not a headline gap.

option_B_feasibility.line: D-prime ships now on existing data. Option B (breadth across task types / method pairs) is the funded follow-up. Critically, more SEEDS will NOT buy power at temperature 0.2 (E2 shows seeds collapse to ~2-3 distinct trajectories per cell); B must add TASKS and task FAMILIES (only code-repair fixtures exist now) and/or raise temperature, not seeds. This is the concrete scaling requirement the editor's point 2 asks for.
option_B_feasibility.cost_note: Compute is the binding constraint (A40 + vLLM, self-hosted). Breadth is a resourcing question, not a design flaw; D-prime does not depend on it.

editor_criticism_response_map.1_exposition_spec_list: Addressed in Phase 6 rewrite (pending): replace the 6.3 setting-list with a what/why narrative anchored on the recurrence model.
editor_criticism_response_map.2_composition_more_extensive_across_task: Acknowledged as a limitation (single code-repair family). Reframed: D-prime does not require breadth; Option B is the scoped follow-up with the seeds-vs-tasks requirement above.
editor_criticism_response_map.3_statistical_relevance_success_split_or: DONE: primary is per-turn (normalised by turns); success-stratified shown descriptively with the collider caveat; degeneracy diagnostic exposes effective-n.
editor_criticism_response_map.4_conclusions_significance: D-prime: a validated predictive recurrence model + precise per-turn null + clean Eq.8 decomposition + the 72% degeneracy finding constitute a measurement contribution, not a non-result.

next_steps_needing_user_go_ahead: Phase 6: create paper_for_TMLR/ (copy from frozen paper_for_AI_review_journal, keep original frozen) and rewrite exposition + integrate D-prime and corpus fixes.
Phase 7: TMLR reformat, relabel SAC, deposit reanalysis/run_summary_enriched.csv to a data repository.
